name: INTERNAT – Futuremedia project auto-fill
description: Every 10 min, sets the Futuremedia project on INTERNAT tickets where it is empty: parent → summary option → linked ticket project → product name → [IU Internationalization].

nodes.name: Find INTERNAT tickets without Futuremedia project

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: project = INTERNAT AND "Futuremedia project" is EMPTY AND created <= -2m ORDER BY created ASC

parameters.content:
## Futuremedia project auto-fill
Every 10 min: finds INTERNAT tickets with an empty Futuremedia project (created 2+ min ago) and sets it.
Order: parent value (sub-tasks) → [BU …] option in summary → linked product ticket project → product name in summary → [IU Internationalization].
